title: Customer workspace
subtitle: Companies where you are set as the customer representative. Only projects you may access appear here: you were added under Team in the marketing cabinet, or you created the project as the company card owner.
filterEmptyDescription: Change your search query or clear the field to see all companies again.
loadError: Could not load the list. Check your connection and try again.

emptyCompanies.title: No linked companies yet
emptyCompanies.description: When your agency assigns you as the customer representative on a company card, it will show up here.

projectsEmpty: No projects with your access yet. The project lead needs to add you under Team in the marketing cabinet. Representatives do not get automatic access to every project in the company.
expandDetails: Show summary, documents, presentations, and chat

workspace.tablistAria: Customer cabinet sections for this project

diagnostic.loadError: Could not load the diagnostic session.
diagnostic.saveError: Could not save answers. Check your connection.
diagnostic.welcomeBody: Five modules: brand archetype, values, business, service, and an emotion map. Answers autosave—you can pause and continue later.
diagnostic.hubHint: Modules unlock in order: finish the previous block first. Progress and answers autosave.
diagnostic.hubAllDoneHint: All modules are done. Open each card for details; use the button below for the full summary with charts.
diagnostic.resultsHint: Narrative summary and charts from your answers.

summary.leadPublishedHint: Your project lead prepares this on the Summary tab under With customer in the marketing cabinet.
summary.emptyDescription: Content will show up after your project lead saves the Summary tab under With customer in the marketing cabinet. They can autofill from the project card and overview there. If another project already has a summary, open that project in the list.

guide.kbdHint: Navigate: Left/Right arrows, Home/End; close with Escape.

intro.title: Customer Cabinet
intro.body: Companies where you are the customer representative and projects you can access from Marketing Cabinet.

header.title: Header
header.body: Title explains access rules. Refresh and Tour buttons on the right.

search.title: Search
search.body: Filters loaded companies/projects by name, industry, or goals.

company-tree.title: Company card
company-tree.body: Name, industry, and accessible projects section.

project-row.title: Project row
project-row.body: Click expands workspace tabs; badges show pending docs and presentations.

workspace.title: Project workspace
workspace.body: Summary, diagnostic, documents, presentations, chat tabs. Tour expands the first project for this step.

refresh.title: Refresh
refresh.body: Reloads companies, projects, and signal badges from the server.

outro.title: Done
outro.body: Pick a project tab and continue. Restart tour from the header.
